com.vector.cfg.dom.runtimesys.groovy.api

Interface ISelectedComponentPorts


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface ISelectedComponentPorts
    ISelectedComponentPorts represents a selection of IComponentPorts and provides simple APIs for further actions (e.g. connecting them to other ports).

    • Method Detail

      • assureConnectedTo

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.List<IConnector> assureConnectedTo(@Nonnull
                                                               java.util.List<IComponentPort> targetPorts)

        assureConnectedTo(List) checks whether the IComponentPorts represented by this ISelectedComponentPorts are already connected to the given targetPorts matching them via index. In contrast to connectTo(List) this method does nothing if the ports are already connected. If the ports are not connected a new connector will be created.

        Parameters:
        targetPorts - The target IComponentPorts for the ports represented by this ISelectedComponentPorts. The order is relevant, the ports will be connected via index to the selected ports.
        Returns:
        Only newly created connectors for the port pairs that were not connected yet. For already connected pairs nothing will be returned. So if an empty list is returned by this method, then all port pairs were already connected.
        Throws:
        SelectionException - If incompatible port pairs were found. See Automation Interface Documentation for more details about the checks.

      • connectTo

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.List<IConnector> connectTo(@Nonnull
                                                       java.util.List<IComponentPort> targetPorts)

        connectTo(List) creates IConnectors between the IComponentPorts which are represented by this ISelectedComponentPorts with the given targetPorts. The ports are connected using the index. The first port of this ISelectedComponentPorts will be connected to the first target port, the second to the second target port and so on.
        In case you want to ignore already connected port pairs please use assureConnectedTo(List).
        If you want to connect ports using name matching please use IRuntimeSystemApi.selectComponentPorts(groovy.lang.Closure).

        Parameters:
        targetPorts - The target IComponentPorts for the new connectors. The order is relevant, the ports will be connected via index to the selected ports.
        Returns:
        The created IConnectors.
        Throws:
        SelectionException - If incompatible port pairs were found or a connection for at least one of the pairs does already exist. See Automation Interface Documentation for more details about the checks.
